session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Wedge Bottom, Then Midday Reversal Down'; internal note 'Weak Small Pullback Bull Trend'. Plain-PT axis (prints 6/5 06:45-13:00, 6/6 edge marker) - clean PT reference image. Reading: early wedge bottom at 4285 with a bad buy signal bar (partial claim), weak small-pullback bull trend with an ii at 08:15 grinding to an expanding-triangle top 4304.5, bar 43 midday reversal with an OO outside bar, then bear surprise with follow-through down to a sell climax 4273/4275 by 11:30 (ii there, 'might test open'), finishing in chop 4275-4287 well below the 4296 open.
